WaterBro legal

Privacy Policy

Effective September 30, 2026

WaterBro is created and operated in the United States by Valeriia Mudrak under the Valeriia Labs brand (“WaterBro,” “we,” “us,” or “our”). This policy explains how WaterBro handles information when you use the app anywhere in the world.

What WaterBro does

WaterBro is a wellness app that lets you record water intake, view daily progress and history, build hydration streaks, set a personal goal, receive optional reminders, and create a progress card that you can choose to share.

WaterBro is a general wellness tool. It is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice.

Information processed by WaterBro

WaterBro processes the following information to provide its features:

  • The amount and time of each water entry.
  • An optional display name if you create a WaterBro profile.
  • Your daily goal, preferred unit, appearance, reminder schedule, optional star rating, and three-day preview start date.
  • A locally cached access status after the App Store verifies a lifetime purchase.

WaterBro does not ask for your email address, phone number, physical address, precise location, contacts, photos, or payment-card details.

Where information is stored

Hydration entries and an optional profile are stored locally on your device using Apple’s SwiftData technology. App settings are stored locally using Apple system storage.

When you are signed in to iCloud and iCloud is available, hydration entries and your optional profile can sync through your private CloudKit database to other devices using the same Apple Account. Private CloudKit records are owned by you and are not visible to Valeriia Mudrak through the CloudKit developer portal by default.

WaterBro does not operate its own account, analytics, advertising, or data-storage server.

Apple services

WaterBro uses the following Apple services:

  • StoreKit to offer and verify an optional one-time lifetime purchase.
  • iCloud and CloudKit to provide private synchronization when available.
  • Notifications to schedule reminders when you grant permission and to support CloudKit synchronization.
  • App Store review services when you choose the review option.
  • Apple diagnostic services if you separately choose to share diagnostics with Apple through your device settings.

WaterBro does not use HealthKit or Sign in with Apple. Apple processes information under its own privacy policies. WaterBro does not receive your complete payment-card details.

Analytics, advertising, and tracking

WaterBro does not include third-party analytics, third-party crash reporting, advertising, attribution SDKs, or data-broker integrations. We do not track you across apps or websites and do not sell personal information.

Sharing and external services

When you tap Share, WaterBro creates a progress image on your device and opens the standard iOS share sheet. The image is provided to Instagram or another destination only after you select that destination. The chosen service’s privacy policy then applies.

The support button opens your email app. If you send a message, your email provider and our email provider, currently Gmail, process the message under their own policies. Please do not include sensitive medical information in support requests.

WaterBro may link to an external public-health resource, such as the CDC website. External websites have their own privacy practices.

Accounts

You do not need an account with Valeriia Mudrak or Valeriia Labs to use WaterBro. The optional WaterBro profile does not have a separate password. Private synchronization uses the Apple Account already signed in on your device. WaterBro remains usable offline without iCloud, subject to the app’s access terms.

Data retention and deletion

Your records remain on your device and, when enabled, in your private iCloud database until you delete them or remove the relevant storage.

You can:

  • Delete individual entries from History.
  • Delete all hydration history from Settings.
  • Delete your optional profile and hydration history from Profile → Account.

Deletions are sent to iCloud when synchronization is available. Uninstalling WaterBro removes local app data but may not remove copies stored in your private iCloud database. If necessary, reinstall WaterBro while signed in to the same Apple Account and use the in-app deletion controls.

Because private CloudKit records are not accessible to us through the developer portal by default, we generally cannot inspect or manually delete those records for you. Contact us if you need help using the deletion controls.

Children

WaterBro is not directed to children under 13 and is not offered in the App Store Kids Category. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. Where local law requires parental consent at a higher age, a parent or guardian should approve use of the app.

Security and international availability

WaterBro uses Apple’s platform storage and transaction protections. No storage or transmission method can be guaranteed to be completely secure.

WaterBro is available worldwide. Apple may process information in countries or regions described in Apple’s privacy materials. Mandatory privacy rights in your country or region continue to apply.

Changes to this policy

We may update this Privacy Policy when WaterBro’s features, legal requirements, or information practices change. We will update the effective date and provide additional notice when appropriate.
